import objects = "./object_parser.qui"

class Member(objects.Object object_file, string[] exports, loaded := false)
class Library(Member[] members)
class Decision<T>(T state, bool extracted)
class ScanResult<T>(T state, Library library, bool extracted)

Library parse(string name)
    lines := objects.read_lines(name)
    Member[] members := []
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#lines)
        fields := lines[cursor].split(" ")
        cursor += 1
        start := cursor
        while lines[cursor] != "end"
            cursor += 1
        cursor += 1
        members = members.append(Member(objects.parse("{name}({fields[1]})", lines[start:<cursor]), fields[2:<int(#fields)]))
    return Library(members)

ScanResult<T> scan<T>(Library library, T state, func<Decision<T>(T, Member)> extract)
    any_extracted := false
    while true
        changed := false
        for: index < int(#library.members)
            if library.members[index].loaded
                continue
            Decision<T> decision := extract(state, library.members[index])
            state = decision.state
            if decision.extracted
                library.members[index].loaded = true
                changed = true
                any_extracted = true
        if not changed
            return ScanResult<T>(state, library, any_extracted)

import objects = "./object_parser.qui"

class MergedPosition(objects.Reference reference, int offset, int merged)
class MergedData(sections := 0, strings := 0, unique := 0, saved := 0, MergedPosition[] positions := [])
class Component(string kind, int size, int alignment, int[] data := [], reference := objects.Reference(-1, -1), name := "", merged := MergedData(), address := 0)
class Output(string name, Component[] components := [], address := 0, size := 0, alignment := 1)
class Segment(string name, int base, int length, int fill, int[] outputs, memsz := 0, filesz := 0, paddr := 0, used := 0, int[] image := [])

int modulo(int value, int divisor)
    remainder := value % divisor
    return if remainder < 0 then remainder + divisor else remainder

int align(int value, int alignment)
    return value + modulo(alignment - modulo(value, alignment), alignment)

int output_index(string name, const Output[] outputs)
    for: index < int(#outputs)
        if objects.belongs(name, outputs[index].name)
            return index
    return -1

void assign(Segment &segment, Output[] &outputs)
    cursor := segment.base
    segment.filesz = 0
    for index := segment.outputs[]
        output := outputs[index]
        output.alignment = 1
        for component := output.components[]
            if component.alignment > output.alignment
                output.alignment = component.alignment
        cursor = align(cursor, output.alignment)
        output.address = cursor
        for: component_index < int(#output.components)
            cursor = align(cursor, output.components[component_index].alignment)
            output.components[component_index].address = cursor
            cursor += output.components[component_index].size
        output.size = cursor - output.address
        if not objects.nobits(output.name)
            segment.filesz = cursor - segment.base
        outputs[index] = output
    segment.memsz = cursor - segment.base
    segment.paddr = segment.base
    segment.used = segment.memsz

import collections
import objects = "./object_parser.qui"
import archive = "./archive.qui"
import resolver = "./resolver.qui"
import layout = "./layout.qui"
import relocator = "./relocator.qui"

class NamedPair(string first, string second)
class VeneerPair(int output, string name)
class Comdat(string signature, string keeper, string[] discarded := [])
class Extraction(string object_name, string referrer, string reason)
class Unit(string kind, reference := objects.Reference(-1, -1), name := "")
class SymbolLine(int address, string name, string kind, string definer)
class Context(entry := "", gc := true, layout.Segment[] segments := [], layout.Output[] outputs := [], NamedPair[] loads := [], string[] keeps := [], string[] sorts := [], string[] wraps := [], NamedPair[] defines := [], NamedPair | none checksum := none, string[][] inputs := [], objects.Object[] loaded := [], libraries := map<string, archive.Library>(), entries := map<string, objects.Reference[]>(), string[] global_names := [], resolver.Resolution[] resolutions := [], indices := map<string, int>(), Comdat[] comdats := [], Extraction[] extractions := [], VeneerPair[] veneers := [])
class Script(string[] tokens, map<string, int> values, layout.Output[] outputs, layout.Segment[] segments, cursor := 0)

bool contains<T>(const T[] items, T sought)
    for item := items[]
        if item == sought
            return true
    return false

int minimum(int first, int second)
    return if first < second then first else second

int number(string text)
    return if text.starts_with("0x") then objects.hex_number(text[2:<int(#text)]) else int(text)

string hex(int amount, width := 8, uppercase := false)
    alphabet := if uppercase then "0123456789ABCDEF" else "0123456789abcdef"
    result := ""
    while amount > 0 or result == ""
        result = alphabet[amount % 16] + result
        amount /= 16
    while int(#result) < width
        result = "0" + result
    return result

int resolution_index(const Context context, string name)
    match context.indices.get(name)
        int index
            return index
        none
            return -1

int segment_index(const Context context, string name)
    for: index < int(#context.segments)
        if context.segments[index].name == name
            return index
    return -1

bool script_name(const Context context, string name)
    for definition := context.defines[]
        if definition.first == name
            return true
    return false

objects.Reference[] entries_for(const Context context, string name)
    match context.entries.get(name)
        objects.Reference[] entries
            return entries
        none
            return []

Context read_script()
    context := Context()
    for line := objects.read_lines("link.txt")[]
        fields := line.split(" ")
        directive := fields[0]
        if directive == "entry"
            context.entry = fields[1]
        elif directive == "gc"
            context.gc = fields[1] == "on"
        elif directive == "segment"
            int[] indices := []
            for name := fields[5:<int(#fields)][]
                indices = indices.append(int(#context.outputs))
                context.outputs = context.outputs.append(layout.Output(name))
            context.segments = context.segments.append(layout.Segment(fields[1], number(fields[2]), number(fields[3]), number(fields[4]), indices))
        elif directive == "load"
            context.loads = context.loads.append(NamedPair(fields[1], fields[2]))
        elif directive == "keep"
            context.keeps = context.keeps.append(fields[1])
        elif directive == "sort"
            context.sorts = context.sorts.append(fields[1])
        elif directive == "wrap"
            context.wraps = context.wraps.append(fields[1])
        elif directive == "define"
            parts := line.split(" = ")
            context.defines = context.defines.append(NamedPair(fields[1], parts[1]))
        elif directive == "checksum"
            context.checksum = NamedPair(fields[1], fields[2])
        else
            context.inputs = context.inputs.append(fields)
    return context

bool undefined_name(const Context context, string name)
    if script_name(context, name)
        return false
    entries := entries_for(context, name)
    global_reference := false
    for entry := entries[]
        objects.Symbol symbol := context.loaded[entry.object_index].symbols[entry.index]
        if symbol.definition.kind != "undefined"
            return false
        global_reference = global_reference or symbol.binding == "global"
    return name == context.entry or global_reference

void load_object(Context &context, objects.Object object_file)
    for group := object_file.groups[]
        keeper := -1
        for: index < int(#context.comdats)
            if context.comdats[index].signature == group.signature
                keeper = index
                break
        if keeper >= 0
            for index := group.sections[]
                object_file.sections[index].discard = "comdat"
            context.comdats[keeper].discarded = context.comdats[keeper].discarded.append(object_file.name)
        else
            context.comdats = context.comdats.append(Comdat(group.signature, object_file.name))
    for: index < int(#object_file.symbols)
        objects.Symbol symbol := object_file.symbols[index]
        if symbol.binding != "local" and symbol.definition.kind == "section" and object_file.sections[symbol.definition.section].discard == "comdat"
            symbol.definition = objects.Definition("undefined")
        if symbol.definition.kind == "undefined"
            if contains(context.wraps, symbol.name)
                symbol.name = "__wrap_" + symbol.name
            elif symbol.name.starts_with("__real_") and contains(context.wraps, symbol.name[7:<int(#symbol.name)])
                symbol.name = symbol.name[7:<int(#symbol.name)]
        object_file.symbols[index] = symbol
    object_index := int(#context.loaded)
    for: index < int(#object_file.symbols)
        objects.Symbol symbol := object_file.symbols[index]
        if symbol.binding != "local"
            entries := entries_for(context, symbol.name)
            entries = entries.append(objects.Reference(object_index, index))
            .context.entries.set(symbol.name, entries)
    context.loaded = context.loaded.append(object_file)

archive.Decision<Context> extract_member(Context context, archive.Member member)
    reason := ""
    for name := member.exports[]
        if undefined_name(context, name)
            reason = name
            break
    if reason == ""
        return archive.Decision<Context>(context, false)
    referrer := "*entry*"
    for entry := entries_for(context, reason)[]
        objects.Symbol symbol := context.loaded[entry.object_index].symbols[entry.index]
        if symbol.definition.kind == "undefined" and symbol.binding == "global"
            referrer = context.loaded[entry.object_index].name
            break
    context.extractions = context.extractions.append(Extraction(member.object_file.name, referrer, reason))
    load_object(&context, member.object_file)
    return archive.Decision<Context>(context, true)

bool scan_library(Context &context, string name)
    library := archive.Library([])
    match context.libraries.get(name)
        archive.Library found
            library = found
        none
            library = archive.parse(name)
    archive.ScanResult<Context> result := archive.scan(library, context, extract_member)
    context = result.state
    .context.libraries.set(name, result.library)
    return result.extracted

void load_inputs(Context &context)
    for fields := context.inputs[]
        if fields[0] == "object"
            load_object(&context, objects.parse(fields[1], objects.read_lines(fields[1])))
        elif fields[0] == "library"
            extracted := scan_library(&context, fields[1])
        else
            while true
                changed := false
                for name := fields[1:<int(#fields)][]
                    extracted := scan_library(&context, name)
                    changed = changed or extracted
                if not changed
                    break
    names := context.entries.keys()
    for definition := context.defines[]
        if not contains(names, definition.first)
            names = names.append(definition.first)
    context.global_names = names.sorted()
    for name := context.global_names[]
        .context.indices.set(name, int(#context.resolutions))
        context.resolutions = context.resolutions.append(resolver.resolve(context.loaded, entries_for(context, name), script_name(context, name)))
    for: object_index < int(#context.loaded)
        for: index < int(#context.loaded[object_index].sections)
            objects.Section section := context.loaded[object_index].sections[index]
            if section.discard == ""
                section.output = layout.output_index(section.name, context.outputs)
                if section.output == -1
                    section.discard = "orphan"
            context.loaded[object_index].sections[index] = section

Unit | none definition_unit(const Context context, string name)
    index := resolution_index(context, name)
    if index < 0
        return none
    resolution := context.resolutions[index]
    if resolution.kind == "common"
        return Unit("common", name = name)
    match resolution.definition
        objects.Reference reference
            objects.Definition definition := context.loaded[reference.object_index].symbols[reference.index].definition
            return Unit("section", objects.Reference(reference.object_index, definition.section))
        none
            return none

Unit | none target_unit(const Context context, int object_index, const objects.Relocation relocation)
    objects.Symbol symbol := context.loaded[object_index].symbols[relocation.symbol]
    if symbol.binding == "local"
        return Unit("section", objects.Reference(object_index, symbol.definition.section))
    return definition_unit(context, symbol.name)

void collect_live(Context &context)
    Unit[] pending := []
    for: object_index < int(#context.loaded)
        for: index < int(#context.loaded[object_index].sections)
            objects.Section section := context.loaded[object_index].sections[index]
            if section.discard == "" and (not context.gc or contains(context.keeps, context.outputs[section.output].name))
                pending = pending.append(Unit("section", objects.Reference(object_index, index)))
    if not context.gc
        for name := context.global_names[]
            if context.resolutions[resolution_index(context, name)].kind == "common"
                pending = pending.append(Unit("common", name = name))
    match definition_unit(context, context.entry)
        Unit unit
            pending = pending.append(unit)
        none
            pending = pending
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#pending)
        unit := pending[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        if unit.kind == "common"
            context.resolutions[resolution_index(context, unit.name)].live = true
            continue
        object_index := unit.reference.object_index
        index := unit.reference.index
        objects.Section section := context.loaded[object_index].sections[index]
        if section.live or section.discard != ""
            continue
        context.loaded[object_index].sections[index].live = true
        for relocation := context.loaded[object_index].relocations[]
            if relocation.section == index
                match target_unit(context, object_index, relocation)
                    Unit target
                        pending = pending.append(target)
                    none
                        continue
    for: object_index < int(#context.loaded)
        for: index < int(#context.loaded[object_index].sections)
            if context.loaded[object_index].sections[index].discard == "" and not context.loaded[object_index].sections[index].live
                context.loaded[object_index].sections[index].discard = "gc"
    for: index < int(#context.resolutions)
        match context.resolutions[index].definition
            objects.Reference reference
                int section_index := context.loaded[reference.object_index].symbols[reference.index].definition.section
                context.resolutions[index].live = context.loaded[reference.object_index].sections[section_index].live
            none
                continue

layout.Component merge_strings(const Context context, const objects.Reference[] sections)
    int[][] unique_strings := []
    int[] offsets := []
    int[] data := []
    layout.MergedPosition[] positions := []
    count := 0
    total := 0
    for reference := sections[]
        objects.Section section := context.loaded[reference.object_index].sections[reference.index]
        total += section.size
        start := 0
        for: finish < int(#section.data)
            if section.data[finish] != 0
                continue
            bytes := section.data[start:<finish + 1]
            position := -1
            for: index < int(#unique_strings)
                if unique_strings[index] == bytes
                    position = offsets[index]
                    break
            if position == -1
                position = int(#data)
                unique_strings = unique_strings.append(bytes)
                offsets = offsets.append(position)
                data = data.concat(bytes)
            positions = positions.append(layout.MergedPosition(reference, start, position))
            count += 1
            start = finish + 1
    merged := layout.MergedData(int(#sections), count, int(#unique_strings), total - int(#data), positions)
    return layout.Component("merged", int(#data), 1, data, merged = merged)

int section_priority(const Context context, const objects.Reference reference, string output_name)
    string name := context.loaded[reference.object_index].sections[reference.index].name
    return if name == output_name then 65536 else int(name[int(#output_name) + 1:<int(#name)])

void perform_layout(Context &context)
    for: output_index < int(#context.outputs)
        output := context.outputs[output_index]
        objects.Reference[] sections := []
        for: object_index < int(#context.loaded)
            for: index < int(#context.loaded[object_index].sections)
                objects.Section section := context.loaded[object_index].sections[index]
                if section.live and section.output == output_index
                    sections = sections.append(objects.Reference(object_index, index))
        if contains(context.sorts, output.name)
            for: index < int(#sections)
                reference := sections[index]
                cursor := index
                priority := section_priority(context, reference, output.name)
                while cursor > 0 and section_priority(context, sections[cursor - 1], output.name) > priority
                    sections[cursor] = sections[cursor - 1]
                    cursor -= 1
                sections[cursor] = reference
        objects.Reference[] string_sections := []
        for reference := sections[]
            if objects.string_section(context.loaded[reference.object_index].sections[reference.index].name)
                string_sections = string_sections.append(reference)
        layout.Component[] components := []
        emitted := false
        for reference := sections[]
            objects.Section section := context.loaded[reference.object_index].sections[reference.index]
            if objects.string_section(section.name)
                if not emitted
                    components = components.append(merge_strings(context, string_sections))
                    emitted = true
            else
                components = components.append(layout.Component("input", section.size, section.alignment, section.data, reference))
        if output.name == ".bss"
            string[] commons := []
            for name := context.global_names[]
                resolution := context.resolutions[resolution_index(context, name)]
                if resolution.kind == "common" and resolution.live
                    commons = commons.append(name)
            for: index < int(#commons)
                name := commons[index]
                alignment := context.resolutions[resolution_index(context, name)].alignment
                cursor := index
                while cursor > 0 and context.resolutions[resolution_index(context, commons[cursor - 1])].alignment < alignment
                    commons[cursor] = commons[cursor - 1]
                    cursor -= 1
                commons[cursor] = name
            for name := commons[]
                resolution := context.resolutions[resolution_index(context, name)]
                components = components.append(layout.Component("common", resolution.size, resolution.alignment, name = name))
        string[] veneer_names := []
        for pair := context.veneers[]
            if pair.output == output_index
                veneer_names = veneer_names.append(pair.name)
        for name := veneer_names.sorted()[]
            components = components.append(layout.Component("veneer", 8, 4, name = name))
        context.outputs[output_index].components = components
    for: index < int(#context.segments)
        layout.assign(&context.segments[index], &context.outputs)
    for output := context.outputs[]
        for component := output.components[]
            if component.kind == "input"
                context.loaded[component.reference.object_index].sections[component.reference.index].address = component.address
            elif component.kind == "merged"
                for position := component.merged.positions[]
                    .context.loaded[position.reference.object_index].sections[position.reference.index].strings.set(position.offset, component.address + position.merged)
            elif component.kind == "common"
                context.resolutions[resolution_index(context, component.name)].address = component.address
    for: index < int(#context.resolutions)
        match context.resolutions[index].definition
            objects.Reference reference
                objects.Definition definition := context.loaded[reference.object_index].symbols[reference.index].definition
                objects.Section section := context.loaded[reference.object_index].sections[definition.section]
                address := section.address + definition.offset
                if objects.string_section(section.name) and section.live
                    match section.strings.get(definition.offset)
                        int found
                            address = found
                        none
                            address = address
                context.resolutions[index].address = address
            none
                continue

bool is_far(const Context context, int object_index, const objects.Relocation relocation)
    objects.Section section := context.loaded[object_index].sections[relocation.section]
    objects.Symbol symbol := context.loaded[object_index].symbols[relocation.symbol]
    index := resolution_index(context, symbol.name)
    if not section.live or relocation.kind != "CALL24" or symbol.binding == "local" or index < 0
        return false
    resolution := context.resolutions[index]
    return (resolution.kind == "global" or resolution.kind == "weak") and not relocator.fits("CALL24", resolution.address + relocation.addend - section.address - relocation.offset)

int script_expression(Script &parser);

int script_term(Script &parser)
    token := parser.tokens[parser.cursor]
    parser.cursor += 1
    if token == "("
        amount := script_expression(&parser)
        parser.cursor += 1
        return amount
    if token[0].codepoints()[0] >= 48 and token[0].codepoints()[0] <= 57
        return number(token)
    if parser.cursor == int(#parser.tokens) or parser.tokens[parser.cursor] != "("
        match parser.values.get(token)
            int amount
                return amount
            none
                return 0
    parser.cursor += 1
    if token == "align"
        amount := script_expression(&parser)
        parser.cursor += 1
        alignment := script_expression(&parser)
        parser.cursor += 1
        return layout.align(amount, alignment)
    name := parser.tokens[parser.cursor]
    parser.cursor += 2
    index := -1
    for: candidate < int(#parser.outputs)
        if parser.outputs[candidate].name == name
            index = candidate
            break
    output := parser.outputs[index]
    if token == "start"
        return output.address
    if token == "end"
        return output.address + output.size
    if token == "size"
        return output.size
    for segment := parser.segments[]
        if contains(segment.outputs, index)
            return segment.paddr + output.address - segment.base
    return 0

int script_expression(Script &parser)
    amount := script_term(&parser)
    while parser.cursor < int(#parser.tokens) and (parser.tokens[parser.cursor] == "+" or parser.tokens[parser.cursor] == "-")
        operation := parser.tokens[parser.cursor]
        parser.cursor += 1
        right := script_term(&parser)
        amount = if operation == "+" then amount + right else amount - right
    return amount

string[] expression_tokens(string text)
    string[] tokens := []
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#text)
        if text[cursor] == " "
            cursor += 1
            continue
        start := cursor
        if "(),+-".contains(text[cursor])
            cursor += 1
        else
            while cursor < int(#text) and text[cursor] != " " and not "(),+-".contains(text[cursor])
                cursor += 1
        tokens = tokens.append(text[start:<cursor])
    return tokens

void finish_layout(Context &context)
    while true
        perform_layout(&context)
        changed := false
        for: object_index < int(#context.loaded)
            for relocation := context.loaded[object_index].relocations[]
                if is_far(context, object_index, relocation)
                    pair := VeneerPair(context.loaded[object_index].sections[relocation.section].output, context.loaded[object_index].symbols[relocation.symbol].name)
                    if not contains(context.veneers, pair)
                        context.veneers = context.veneers.append(pair)
                        changed = true
        if not changed
            break
    int[] storage := []
    for segment := context.segments[]
        storage = storage.append(segment.base + segment.memsz)
    for pair := context.loads[]
        first := segment_index(context, pair.first)
        second := segment_index(context, pair.second)
        context.segments[first].paddr = layout.align(storage[second], 4)
        storage[second] = context.segments[first].paddr + context.segments[first].filesz
    for: index < int(#context.segments)
        context.segments[index].used = storage[index] - context.segments[index].base
    map<string, int> values
    for definition := context.defines[]
        parser := Script(expression_tokens(definition.second), values, context.outputs, context.segments)
        amount := script_expression(&parser)
        .values.set(definition.first, amount)
        context.resolutions[resolution_index(context, definition.first)].address = amount

int | none symbol_value(const Context context, int object_index, int index)
    objects.Symbol symbol := context.loaded[object_index].symbols[index]
    if symbol.binding == "local"
        objects.Section section := context.loaded[object_index].sections[symbol.definition.section]
        if objects.string_section(section.name)
            return section.strings.get(symbol.definition.offset)
        return section.address + symbol.definition.offset
    resolution := context.resolutions[resolution_index(context, symbol.name)]
    return if resolution.kind == "undefined" then none else resolution.address

string[] base_diagnostics(const Context context)
    string[] lines := []
    map<string, int> orphans
    for object_file := context.loaded[]
        for section := object_file.sections[]
            if section.discard == "orphan"
                count := 0
                match orphans.get(section.name)
                    int found
                        count = found
                    none
                        count = 0
                .orphans.set(section.name, count + 1)
    orphan_names := orphans.keys()
    for name := orphan_names.sorted()[]
        match orphans.get(name)
            int count
                lines = lines.append("warning: orphan section {name} discarded from {count} object(s)")
            none
                continue
    for name := context.global_names[]
        resolution := context.resolutions[resolution_index(context, name)]
        string[] definers := if resolution.kind == "script" then ["*script*"] else []
        for object_index := resolution.strong[]
            definers = definers.append(context.loaded[object_index].name)
        if #definers >= 2
            lines = lines.append("error: multiple definition of {name}: " + definers.join(" "))
        if #resolution.commons > 0 and (resolution.kind == "global" or resolution.kind == "script")
            lines = lines.append("warning: common symbol {name} overridden by {resolution.definer}")
        resolver.CommonPair[] unique_pairs := []
        for pair := resolution.commons[]
            if not contains(unique_pairs, pair)
                unique_pairs = unique_pairs.append(pair)
        if resolution.kind == "common" and #unique_pairs >= 2
            lines = lines.append("warning: common symbol {name} merged to size {resolution.size} align {resolution.alignment}")
    entry_index := resolution_index(context, context.entry)
    if entry_index < 0 or context.resolutions[entry_index].kind == "undefined" or context.resolutions[entry_index].kind == "weakundef"
        lines = lines.append("error: entry symbol {context.entry} is undefined")
    for name := context.global_names[]
        if context.resolutions[resolution_index(context, name)].kind != "undefined"
            continue
        string[] referrers := []
        for object_file := context.loaded[]
            referenced := false
            for relocation := object_file.relocations[]
                objects.Symbol symbol := object_file.symbols[relocation.symbol]
                if object_file.sections[relocation.section].live and symbol.binding != "local" and symbol.name == name
                    referenced = true
                    break
            if referenced
                referrers = referrers.append(object_file.name)
        if #referrers > 0
            lines = lines.append("error: undefined symbol {name} referenced by " + referrers.join(" "))
    for segment := context.segments[]
        if segment.used > segment.length
            lines = lines.append("error: segment {segment.name} overflows its length by {segment.used - segment.length} bytes")
    for: first < int(#context.segments)
        for: first + 1 <= second < int(#context.segments)
            a := context.segments[first]
            b := context.segments[second]
            if a.memsz > 0 and b.memsz > 0 and a.base < b.base + b.memsz and b.base < a.base + a.memsz
                lines = lines.append("error: segments {a.name} and {b.name} overlap")
    return lines

int veneer_address(const Context context, int output, string name)
    for component := context.outputs[output].components[]
        if component.kind == "veneer" and component.name == name
            return component.address
    return 0

string[] relocate(Context &context, string[] &diagnostics)
    string[] lines := []
    kinds := relocator.types()
    int[][] counts := array(#kinds, fill = [0, 0, 0, 0])
    objects.Reference[] order := []
    for output := context.outputs[]
        for component := output.components[]
            if component.kind == "input"
                order = order.append(component.reference)
    gp := 0
    gp_index := resolution_index(context, "_gp")
    if gp_index >= 0
        gp = context.resolutions[gp_index].address
    for reference := order[]
        object_index := reference.object_index
        object_file := context.loaded[object_index]
        objects.Section section := object_file.sections[reference.index]
        objects.Relocation[] relocations := []
        for relocation := object_file.relocations[]
            if relocation.section == reference.index
                relocations = relocations.append(relocation)
        for: index < int(#relocations)
            relocation := relocations[index]
            string symbol_name := object_file.symbols[relocation.symbol].name
            location := "{object_file.name} {section.name}+{relocation.offset}"
            position := section.address + relocation.offset
            if relocator.unpaired(relocations, index)
                diagnostics = diagnostics.append("error: unpaired HI16 at {location} against {symbol_name}")
            int | none selected := symbol_value(context, object_index, relocation.symbol)
            status := "ok"
            if is_far(context, object_index, relocation)
                selected = veneer_address(context, section.output, symbol_name)
                status = "veneer"
            prefix := "{hex(position)} {location} {relocation.kind} {symbol_name} {relocation.addend}"
            match selected
                int address
                    amount := relocator.value(relocation.kind, address, relocation.addend, position, gp)
                    field_value := relocator.field(relocation.kind, amount)
                    count := relocator.width(relocation.kind)
                    if not relocator.fits(relocation.kind, amount)
                        status = "overflow"
                        diagnostics = diagnostics.append("error: relocation overflow at {location}: {relocation.kind} value {amount} against {symbol_name}")
                    bytes := relocator.little(field_value, count)
                    for: byte_index < count
                        context.loaded[object_index].sections[reference.index].data[relocation.offset + byte_index] = bytes[byte_index]
                    lines = lines.append(prefix + " {hex(address)} {amount} {hex(field_value, count * 2)} {status}")
                none
                    status = "undefined"
                    lines = lines.append(prefix + " - - - undefined")
            status_index := if status == "ok" then 0 elif status == "veneer" then 1 elif status == "overflow" then 2 else 3
            for: kind_index < int(#kinds)
                if kinds[kind_index] == relocation.kind
                    counts[kind_index][status_index] += 1
                    break
    for: index < int(#kinds)
        tally := counts[index]
        total := tally[0] + tally[1] + tally[2] + tally[3]
        lines = lines.append("summary {kinds[index]} total {total} ok {tally[0]} veneer {tally[1]} overflow {tally[2]} undefined {tally[3]}")
    return lines

void make_images(Context &context)
    for: index < int(#context.segments)
        segment := context.segments[index]
        image := array(nat(segment.filesz), fill = segment.fill)
        for output_index := segment.outputs[]
            output := context.outputs[output_index]
            if objects.nobits(output.name)
                continue
            for component := output.components[]
                int[] data := component.data
                if component.kind == "input"
                    data = context.loaded[component.reference.object_index].sections[component.reference.index].data
                elif component.kind == "veneer"
                    address := context.resolutions[resolution_index(context, component.name)].address
                    data = [4, 240, 31, 229].concat(relocator.little(address, 4))
                int offset := component.address - segment.base
                for: byte_index < int(#data)
                    image[offset + byte_index] = data[byte_index]
        context.segments[index].image = image
    match context.checksum
        NamedPair pair
            index := segment_index(context, pair.first)
            offset := context.resolutions[resolution_index(context, pair.second)].address - context.segments[index].base
            image := context.segments[index].image
            for: byte_index < 4
                image[offset + byte_index] = 0
            total := 0
            weight := 1
            for: byte_index < int(#image)
                total += image[byte_index] * weight
                weight = if byte_index % 4 == 3 then 1 else weight * 256
            bytes := relocator.little(layout.modulo(-total, 4294967296), 4)
            for: byte_index < 4
                image[offset + byte_index] = bytes[byte_index]
            context.segments[index].image = image
        none
            return

string[] map_lines(const Context context)
    string[] lines := []
    SymbolLine[] symbols := []
    for extraction := context.extractions[]
        lines = lines.append("member {extraction.object_name} {extraction.referrer} {extraction.reason}")
    for group := context.comdats[]
        discarded := if #group.discarded == 0 then "-" else group.discarded.join(",")
        lines = lines.append("comdat {group.signature} {group.keeper} {discarded}")
    for segment := context.segments[]
        lines = lines.append("segment {segment.name} vaddr {hex(segment.base)} paddr {hex(segment.paddr)} filesz {segment.filesz} memsz {segment.memsz} used {segment.used} length {segment.length} {100 * segment.used / segment.length}%")
        for index := segment.outputs[]
            output := context.outputs[index]
            lines = lines.append("section {output.name} {hex(output.address)} {output.size} {output.alignment}")
            for component := output.components[]
                address := hex(component.address)
                if component.kind == "input"
                    object_file := context.loaded[component.reference.object_index]
                    objects.Section section := object_file.sections[component.reference.index]
                    lines = lines.append("input {address} {component.size} {component.alignment} {object_file.name} {section.name}")
                elif component.kind == "merged"
                    layout.MergedData merged := component.merged
                    lines = lines.append("merged {address} {component.size} sections {merged.sections} strings {merged.strings} unique {merged.unique} saved {merged.saved}")
                elif component.kind == "common"
                    definer := context.resolutions[resolution_index(context, component.name)].definer
                    lines = lines.append("common {address} {component.size} {component.alignment} {definer} {component.name}")
                else
                    lines = lines.append("veneer {address} 8 {component.name}")
                    symbols = symbols.append(SymbolLine(component.address, "__veneer_" + component.name, "veneer", "*linker*"))
    for object_file := context.loaded[]
        for section := object_file.sections[]
            if section.discard != ""
                lines = lines.append("discard {object_file.name} {section.name} {section.size} {section.discard}")
    for name := context.global_names[]
        resolution := context.resolutions[resolution_index(context, name)]
        if resolution.kind == "common" and not resolution.live
            lines = lines.append("discard {resolution.definer} COMMON({name}) {resolution.size} gc")
        if resolution.live and contains(["global", "weak", "common", "script"], resolution.kind)
            symbols = symbols.append(SymbolLine(resolution.address, name, resolution.kind, resolution.definer))
    for: index < int(#symbols)
        symbol := symbols[index]
        cursor := index
        while cursor > 0 and (symbols[cursor - 1].address > symbol.address or (symbols[cursor - 1].address == symbol.address and collections.lex_compare(symbols[cursor - 1].name.codepoints(), symbol.name.codepoints()) > 0))
            symbols[cursor] = symbols[cursor - 1]
            cursor -= 1
        symbols[cursor] = symbol
    for symbol := symbols[]
        lines = lines.append("symbol {hex(symbol.address)} {symbol.name} {symbol.kind} {symbol.definer}")
    return lines

string[] xref_lines(const Context context)
    string[] lines := []
    for name := context.global_names[]
        resolution := context.resolutions[resolution_index(context, name)]
        status := if resolution.kind == "undefined" or resolution.kind == "weakundef" then "-" elif resolution.live then "kept" else "discarded"
        string[] referrers := []
        for index := resolution.referrers[]
            referrers = referrers.append(context.loaded[index].name)
        list := if #referrers == 0 then "-" else referrers.join(",")
        lines = lines.append("{name} {resolution.kind} {status} {resolution.definer} {list}")
    return lines

string ihex_record(int address, int kind, const int[] data)
    int[] bytes := [int(#data), address / 256, address % 256, kind].concat(data)
    total := 0
    for byte_value := bytes[]
        total += byte_value
    bytes = bytes.append(layout.modulo(-total, 256))
    text := ":"
    for byte_value := bytes[]
        text += hex(byte_value, 2, true)
    return text

void write_lines(string name, const string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/{name}")
    .writer1(if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL)

void write_outputs(const Context context, const string[] relocations, string[] diagnostics)
    entry_address := 0
    index := resolution_index(context, context.entry)
    if index >= 0 and contains(["global", "weak", "common"], context.resolutions[index].kind)
        entry_address = context.resolutions[index].address
    image_lines := ["entry {hex(entry_address)} {context.entry}"]
    for segment := context.segments[]
        image_lines = image_lines.append("segment {segment.name} vaddr {hex(segment.base)} paddr {hex(segment.paddr)} filesz {segment.filesz} memsz {segment.memsz}")
        for: offset < int(#segment.image) step 16
            string[] bytes := []
            for: offset <= byte_index < minimum(offset + 16, int(#segment.image))
                bytes = bytes.append(hex(segment.image[byte_index], 2))
            image_lines = image_lines.append(hex(segment.base + offset) + " " + bytes.join(" "))
    int[] segment_order := []
    for: segment_number < int(#context.segments)
        if context.segments[segment_number].filesz > 0
            segment_order = segment_order.append(segment_number)
    for: position < int(#segment_order)
        segment_number := segment_order[position]
        cursor := position
        while cursor > 0 and context.segments[segment_order[cursor - 1]].paddr > context.segments[segment_number].paddr
            segment_order[cursor] = segment_order[cursor - 1]
            cursor -= 1
        segment_order[cursor] = segment_number
    string[] ihex := []
    upper := 0
    for segment_number := segment_order[]
        segment := context.segments[segment_number]
        offset := 0
        while offset < segment.filesz
            address := segment.paddr + offset
            count := minimum(16, minimum(segment.filesz - offset, 65536 - address % 65536))
            if address / 65536 != upper
                upper = address / 65536
                ihex = ihex.append(ihex_record(0, 4, [upper / 256, upper % 256]))
            ihex = ihex.append(ihex_record(address % 65536, 0, segment.image[offset:<offset + count]))
            offset += count
    entry_bytes := relocator.little(entry_address, 4)
    ihex = ihex.append(ihex_record(0, 5, entry_bytes[::-1])).append(ihex_record(0, 1, []))
    errors := 0
    warnings := 0
    for diagnostic := diagnostics[]
        if diagnostic.starts_with("error")
            errors += 1
        elif diagnostic.starts_with("warning")
            warnings += 1
    diagnostics = diagnostics.append("errors {errors} warnings {warnings}")
    bool exists := file.exists("output")
    if not exists
        file.mkdir("output")
    write_lines("image.hex", image_lines)
    write_lines("flash.ihex", ihex)
    write_lines("link.map", map_lines(context))
    write_lines("xref.txt", xref_lines(context))
    write_lines("relocations.txt", relocations)
    write_lines("diagnostics.txt", diagnostics)

void run_program()
    context := read_script()
    load_inputs(&context)
    collect_live(&context)
    finish_layout(&context)
    diagnostics := base_diagnostics(context)
    relocations := relocate(&context, &diagnostics)
    make_images(&context)
    write_outputs(context, relocations, diagnostics)

if main
    run_program()

class Reference(int object_index, int index)
class Section(string name, int alignment, int size, int[] data := [], discard := "", output := -1, live := false, address := 0, strings := map<int, int>())
class Definition(string kind, section := -1, offset := 0, size := 0, alignment := 1)
class Symbol(string name, string binding, Definition definition)
class Relocation(int section, int offset, string kind, int symbol, int addend)
class Group(string signature, int[] sections)
class Object(string name, Section[] sections := [], Group[] groups := [], Symbol[] symbols := [], Relocation[] relocations := [])

bool belongs(string name, string output)
    return name == output or name.starts_with(output + ".")

bool nobits(string name)
    return belongs(name, ".bss")

bool string_section(string name)
    return belongs(name, ".rodata.str")

string[] read_lines(string name)
    text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/{name}"))
    result := text.split(NL)
    return result[0:<int(#result) - 1]

int hex_number(string text)
    result := 0
    for: index < int(#text)
        character := text[index]
        code := character.codepoints()[0]
        result = result * 16 + (if code <= 57 then code - 48 else code - 87)
    return result

int section_index(const Object object_file, string name)
    for: index < int(#object_file.sections)
        if object_file.sections[index].name == name
            return index
    return -1

int symbol_index(const Object object_file, string name)
    for: index < int(#object_file.symbols)
        if object_file.symbols[index].name == name
            return index
    return -1

Object parse(string name, const string[] lines)
    result := Object(name)
    for line := lines[]
        fields := line.split(" ")
        if fields[0] == "section"
            result.sections = result.sections.append(Section(fields[1], int(fields[2]), int(fields[3])))
        elif fields[0] == "data"
            last := int(#result.sections) - 1
            for: index < int(#fields[1]) step 2
                result.sections[last].data = result.sections[last].data.append(hex_number(fields[1][index:<index + 2]))
        elif fields[0] == "comdat"
            int[] indices := []
            for section_name := fields[2:<int(#fields)][]
                indices = indices.append(section_index(result, section_name))
            result.groups = result.groups.append(Group(fields[1], indices))
        elif fields[0] == "symbol"
            definition := Definition("undefined")
            if fields[3] == "common"
                definition = Definition("common", size = int(fields[4]), alignment = int(fields[5]))
            elif fields[3] != "undef"
                definition = Definition("section", section_index(result, fields[3]), int(fields[4]))
            result.symbols = result.symbols.append(Symbol(fields[1], fields[2], definition))
        elif fields[0] == "reloc"
            result.relocations = result.relocations.append(Relocation(section_index(result, fields[1]), int(fields[2]), fields[3], symbol_index(result, fields[4]), int(fields[5])))
    return result

import objects = "./object_parser.qui"
import layout = "./layout.qui"

string[] types()
    return ["ABS32", "REL32", "ABS16", "HI16", "LO16", "GPREL16", "CALL24"]

int width(string kind)
    return if kind == "ABS32" or kind == "REL32" then 4 elif kind == "CALL24" then 3 else 2

int value(string kind, int symbol, int addend, int position, int gp)
    return symbol + addend - (if kind == "REL32" or kind == "CALL24" then position elif kind == "GPREL16" then gp else 0)

bool fits(string kind, int amount)
    if kind == "ABS32" or kind == "HI16"
        return -2147483648 <= amount < 4294967296
    if kind == "REL32"
        return -2147483648 <= amount < 2147483648
    if kind == "ABS16"
        return -32768 <= amount < 65536
    if kind == "GPREL16"
        return -32768 <= amount < 32768
    if kind == "CALL24"
        return -33554432 <= amount < 33554432
    return true

int field(string kind, int amount)
    if kind == "HI16"
        return layout.modulo((layout.modulo(amount, 4294967296) + 32768) / 65536, 65536)
    if kind == "CALL24"
        quotient := amount / 4
        if amount < 0 and amount % 4 != 0
            quotient -= 1
        return layout.modulo(quotient, 16777216)
    return layout.modulo(amount, if kind == "ABS32" or kind == "REL32" then 4294967296 else 65536)

bool unpaired(const objects.Relocation[] relocations, int index)
    current := relocations[index]
    if current.kind != "HI16"
        return false
    if index + 1 == int(#relocations)
        return true
    following := relocations[index + 1]
    return following.kind != "LO16" or following.symbol != current.symbol or following.addend != current.addend

int[] little(int amount, int count)
    int[] result := []
    for: index < count
        result = result.append(amount % 256)
        amount /= 256
    return result

import objects = "./object_parser.qui"

class CommonPair(int size, int alignment)
class Resolution(kind := "weakundef", objects.Reference | none definition := none, definer := "-", size := 0, alignment := 1, int[] strong := [], CommonPair[] commons := [], int[] referrers := [], live := false, address := 0)

bool contains_index(const int[] indices, int sought)
    for index := indices[]
        if index == sought
            return true
    return false

Resolution resolve(const objects.Object[] loaded, const objects.Reference[] entries, bool script)
    objects.Reference[] strong_definitions := []
    objects.Reference[] weak_definitions := []
    objects.Reference[] common_definitions := []
    global_reference := false
    result := Resolution()
    for entry := entries[]
        symbol := loaded[entry.object_index].symbols[entry.index]
        definition := symbol.definition
        if definition.kind == "section"
            if symbol.binding == "global"
                strong_definitions = strong_definitions.append(entry)
            else
                weak_definitions = weak_definitions.append(entry)
        elif definition.kind == "common"
            common_definitions = common_definitions.append(entry)
            result.commons = result.commons.append(CommonPair(definition.size, definition.alignment))
        else
            if not contains_index(result.referrers, entry.object_index)
                result.referrers = result.referrers.append(entry.object_index)
            global_reference = global_reference or symbol.binding == "global"
    for entry := strong_definitions[]
        result.strong = result.strong.append(entry.object_index)
    if script
        result.kind = "script"
        result.definer = "*script*"
        result.live = true
    elif #strong_definitions > 0
        result.kind = "global"
        result.definition = strong_definitions[0]
        result.definer = loaded[strong_definitions[0].object_index].name
    elif #common_definitions > 0
        result.kind = "common"
        for common := result.commons[]
            if common.size > result.size
                result.size = common.size
            if common.alignment > result.alignment
                result.alignment = common.alignment
        for entry := common_definitions[]
            if loaded[entry.object_index].symbols[entry.index].definition.size == result.size
                result.definer = loaded[entry.object_index].name
                break
    elif #weak_definitions > 0
        result.kind = "weak"
        result.definition = weak_definitions[0]
        result.definer = loaded[weak_definitions[0].object_index].name
    elif global_reference
        result.kind = "undefined"
    return result
